summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing routine monthly matters: declared regular distributions for Class S ($0.16851), Class D ($0.18050) and Class I ($0.18550) shares, payable to holders of record September 30, 2026 and paid on or about October 28, 2026, in cash or via the DRIP. It also reported August 31, 2026 NAVs per class ($24.85/$24.76/$24.28), aggregate NAV of $308.3 million, portfolio fair value of $464.7 million and $176.2 million of debt, plus continuous offering status of up to $2.5 billion in shares, with $290.2 million raised to date. No transactional event; no arbitrage angle.
